check_sql: SELECT country_key, year, source_key, generation_twh FROM dw.fact_generation_annual WHERE generation_twh < 0

description: Generation-mix shares sum to 100% ± 1 per country-year
check_sql: SELECT country_key, year, SUM(share_pct) AS share_sum FROM dw.fact_generation_annual GROUP BY country_key, year HAVING SUM(generation_twh) > 0 AND ABS(SUM(share_pct) - 100) > 1

description: No gaps in a country's year range
check_sql: SELECT country_key, MIN(year) AS first_year, MAX(year) AS last_year, COUNT(DISTINCT year) AS years FROM dw.fact_country_annual GROUP BY country_key HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT year) <> MAX(year) - MIN(year) + 1

description: A country's data ends before the latest year in the warehouse
check_sql: SELECT c.name, MAX(f.year) AS last_year FROM dw.fact_country_annual AS f JOIN dw.dim_country AS c ON c.country_key = f.country_key GROUP BY c.name HAVING MAX(f.year) < (SELECT MAX(year) FROM dw.fact_country_annual)

description: Generation mix sums to Ember's total generation within 0.5%
check_sql: SELECT f.country_key, f.year, SUM(f.generation_twh) AS mix_twh, ca.total_generation_twh FROM dw.fact_generation_annual AS f JOIN dw.fact_country_annual AS ca ON ca.country_key = f.country_key AND ca.year = f.year GROUP BY f.country_key, f.year, ca.total_generation_twh HAVING ca.total_generation_twh > 0 AND ABS(SUM(f.generation_twh) - ca.total_generation_twh) > 0.005 * ca.total_generation_twh

description: Computed renewable share is within 0.1 pp of Ember's own Renewables share
check_sql: SELECT ca.country_key, ca.year, ca.re_share_gen_pct, s.share_of_generation_pct FROM dw.fact_country_annual AS ca JOIN stg.ember_yearly AS s ON s.country_key = ca.country_key AND s.year = ca.year AND s.electricity_source = 'Renewables' WHERE ABS(ca.re_share_gen_pct - s.share_of_generation_pct) > 0.1

description: Every raw Ember row reaches staging (no unknown countries dropped)
check_sql: SELECT r.raw_rows, s.stg_rows FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS raw_rows FROM raw.ember_yearly) AS r CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS stg_rows FROM stg.ember_yearly) AS s WHERE r.raw_rows <> s.stg_rows
